excelUpload.title: Excel Upload
excelUpload.subtitle: Upload property-wise field values when each property requires a different value.
excelUpload.infoAlertTitle: Excel upload uses only active Group from Field Registry.
excelUpload.infoAlertDesc: Download template after selecting enabled Group. System validates property numbers, field access, value format and approval requirement before import.
excelUpload.actionSectionDesc: Use this when each property has different values. Download template from activated Group, upload Excel and validate rows before update.
excelUpload.propertyCriteriaSubtitle: Select criteria to download a pre-populated Excel template with data.
excelUpload.previewDesc: Review the columns and rows imported from the Excel spreadsheet
excelUpload.guidelineModalIntro: Please follow these guidelines when downloading and uploading properties through Excel:
excelUpload.downloadEmptyDesc: Select an enabled Group from the dropdown and click “Download Template” to get a blank Excel sheet with required column headers.
excelUpload.downloadDataDesc: Select a Group and check the “Download with data” checkbox. The property criteria section will appear—select Zone/Ward criteria and click “Download Excel With Data” to download pre-populated property records.
excelUpload.selectCorrectGroupDesc: Click “Upload Excel” to select your file. The system will auto-match the group from the file name, or you can select the correct group manually before clicking “Validate Excel”.
excelUpload.reuploadDesc: If any rows fail validation or are rejected, review the Validation Remarks in the table, correct the values in your Excel sheet, and re-upload the file.
